## Modules

- [LiveVue](https://live-vue.hexdocs.pm/LiveVue.md): LiveVue provides seamless integration between Phoenix LiveView and Vue.js components.
- [LiveVue.Components](https://live-vue.hexdocs.pm/LiveVue.Components.md): Macros to improve the developer experience of crossing the Liveview/Vue boundary.

- [LiveVue.Encoder](https://live-vue.hexdocs.pm/LiveVue.Encoder.md): Protocol for encoding values to JSON for LiveVue.
- [LiveVue.Patch](https://live-vue.hexdocs.pm/LiveVue.Patch.md): Encodes LiveVue patch operations into the compact wire format used by
`data-props-diff` and `data-streams-diff`.
- [LiveVue.Reload](https://live-vue.hexdocs.pm/LiveVue.Reload.md): Utilities for easier integration with Vite in development

- [LiveVue.SSR](https://live-vue.hexdocs.pm/LiveVue.SSR.md): A behaviour for rendering Vue components server-side.
- [LiveVue.SSR.NodeJS](https://live-vue.hexdocs.pm/LiveVue.SSR.NodeJS.md): Implements SSR by using NodeJS package.
- [LiveVue.SSR.QuickBEAM](https://live-vue.hexdocs.pm/LiveVue.SSR.QuickBEAM.md): Implements SSR using an embedded [QuickBEAM](https://hex.pm/packages/quickbeam) JavaScript runtime.
- [LiveVue.SSR.ViteJS](https://live-vue.hexdocs.pm/LiveVue.SSR.ViteJS.md): Implements SSR by making a POST request to `http://{:vite_host}/ssr_render`.
- [LiveVue.SharedPropsView](https://live-vue.hexdocs.pm/LiveVue.SharedPropsView.md): HEEX sigil override that injects LiveVue shared props and `v-socket` into every `<.vue ...>`
tag and LiveVue shortcut component tag.
- [LiveVue.Test](https://live-vue.hexdocs.pm/LiveVue.Test.md): Helpers for testing LiveVue components and views.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix live_vue.install](https://live-vue.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.LiveVue.Install.md): Installer for LiveVue with Vite.
